purpose: Close the remaining railway organization-scoping gaps reported as P2 by the independent review of #5712: GET /railway/wagons accepted ?orgId= and returned any organization's fleet (and an empty organization meant the whole fleet), GET /railway/gu12 returned every organization's GU-12 requests, and POST /railway/gu12/:id/submit sent any organization's request to ETRAN for whoever knew its id. All three now use only the caller's session organization; a foreign request is reported exactly like a missing one. Follows #5712 (merged as 4c4102d8), which restricted wagon status updates and GU-12 creation the same way; this manifest is reused for the branch's next step.
requiredInvariants: The caller organization comes only from the authenticated session (CurrentUser.orgId), never from the request body, query or path.
A missing session organization yields an empty list or a refusal, never every organization's data.
A GU-12 request of another organization is indistinguishable from a missing request: same NotFoundException and message; it is neither submitted nor modified.
No role bypass: ADMIN is an organization membership role here, not platform staff.
No DTO, validation boundary, baseline, register, workflow, dependency or lockfile change.
acceptance: cd apps/api && npx jest src/modules/railway: 3 suites, 48 tests pass.
Mutations: dropping the requestor check in submit fails 3, dropping the list filter fails 2, restoring the old ?orgId= listWagons fails 2 of the 12 new tests.
knownLimitations: Demurrage calculate/list and dealId ownership are not organization-scoped yet; they are the next narrow step.
